So I have something to ask of you then, Shell. I have been searching for someone in particular, someone who could make better use of these remnants, to transform them into something more useful than banners or flags.

There is a place Tylian calls the 'Wildlands', a world untouched by the ravages of war yet inhabited by humans and faint traces of youkai who want nothing more than to live a new life amongst men. Thank you.

So many dead in the months after the crash. So many who just... broke. They couldn't handle it and... there was no room back then for someone who couldn't provide their hands. Those that refused to work, for any reason, had to be exiled to save on our dwindling food supplies. Sometimes I still wonder if some of those Brigands are the ones we exiled all those years ago.

So the two of you decided on it, yeah? More people always makes for a safer trip, so anyone trifling with us is gonna get a beatin'. Right, you two should get to know each other. We'll be on the road for about two days so long as nothing here goes wrong.

So what you want is probably down in the basement, if they haven't cleaned shop. The house though is ours. We worked weeks scoping this for ourselves, so we get first pick. Cops probably wouldn't even care if the house burnt. They're already tied up. Between the guido and the infestations, they've got no chance at stopping us.

Anyways, basement. There's a back-entrance to the basement through the quarantined apartments. That will lead to the basement below the property, which is your game now. The quarantined apartment is also home to some local gunslinger legend, but poor bastard had the whole place seized since the infestation. Probably something good in it for you in there too if you can brave the bloodwasps.

So what? Even if it were true, what's the point of all this? I'm some washed-up fool who couldn't even kill the bastard who ruined me. One old fool like me isn't going to help your motley crew of bizarre men and women. Blue-haired women? Winged people? A half-dead man? I've seen enough of them on this world. Whatever you think, it's not gonna work and you wouldn't want a wreck like me.

And what would I give to you anyways? How am I supposed to be able to help you with what you aliens do? I'm nothing in your fantasy world, nothing! Nothing! No one cares for this rotting world, and nobody would care if I was gone tomorrow! We're already dead!
So you want to defend this train? We could do with the extra help, and since you made all this effort... Well, good thing you showed up then! The Reds are coming. Help us, and we'll help you.

So, I've been taking into consideration that you may need some things to start off right. I can give you the blueprints through the means of a ^green;Uncommon Blueprint Drive^reset; for an exchange of some materials that are out in the wild.

So, a stranger has contacted you and has entrusted you with important information. It would appear this feline is a graduated Terrene Protectorate cadet. Should you trust her? What choice do you have?
So, if you put that collar there on a captured monster, it'll boost their abilities and make them stronger. That, or it can make them explode. Explode with intent, of course.

So, most people around here generally know who's who. Only peasants and bandits here, no room for people doing merchant work. You though? I don't think anyone's seen your face before. All the villages 'round here know each other, because we're all family. You're an odd one out here, but you're not a brigand, and you don't have a village. But not like living in a village is very exciting. Most of the elders still talk tales of what it was like in the black void above.

The Atlantic Salmon is a species of ray-finned fish of the Salmonidae family. It was the third largest of the Salmonidae, behind the Siberian taimen and Pacific Chinook salmon, growing up to a meter in length. Atlantic Salmon were originally found on Earth in the northern Atlantic Ocean and in rivers that flow into it. Most populations are anadromous, hatching in streams and rivers, moving out to see when they grow and then seasonally back upstream to spawn.

The Australasian snapper (Pagrus auratus) or silver seabream is a species of porgie found in coastal waters of Australia, Philippines, Indonesia, mainland China, Taiwan, Japan and New Zealand. Although it is almost universally known in Australia and New Zealand as snapper, it does not belong to the Lutjanidae snapper family. Snapper was an important traditional food for Māori, where snapper bones sometimes make up the majority of archaeological middens.

The Australian Barracuda is a barracuda of the genus Sphyraena which occurs in the south-western Pacific Ocean. The Australian Barracuda prefers cooler in-shore waters, preferring patches of seagrass, seaweed, or sandy areas close to weed patches or reefs. It is a pelagic species which congregates in large shoals and is highly migratory. Their food is made up of smaller fish, cephalopods, crustaceans and bloodworms. It is referred to as an ambush feeder but is also known to actively pursue prey.
The Australian Brown Trout was imported from England, which became possibly one of the most important sport fish to be introduced into Australia. It's mostly found in cool freshwater above 600m.

The Australian sawtail catshark (Figaro boardmani) is a common species of catshark, and part of the Scyliorhinidae family, native to Australia's southern waters and feeding primarily on fishes, crustaceans, and cephalopods. It is found on or near the bottom of the outer continental shelf and upper continental slope. This fish has been known to assemble in groups of a single sex, where reproduction is oviparous, possibly without a well-defined breeding season as-is the case in other catsharks.

The Australian spotted mackerel (Scomberomorus munroi) is a species of fish in the family Scombridae. It was found in the western Pacific along the northern coast of Australia, but could also be found in the Abrolhos Islands region of Western Australia to Coffs Harbour and Kempsey in central New South Wales. It feeds largely on fishes, particularly anchovies and sardines, with smaller quantities of shrimps and squids.

The Canterbury mudfish (Neochanna burrowsius) was found only on the Canterbury Plains in New Zealand. They are able to survive out of water in damp refuges if its wetland habitat dries out periodically over summer. In 2014, the New Zealand Department of Conservation classified the Canterbury mudfish as ''At Risk: Nationally Critical'' with the qualifier C - predicted decline over 70%, over ten years. The IUCN also rated the Canterbury mudfish as ''Critically endangered''.

Most were unlucky, being immediately consumed by hordes of feral youkai, but enough survived to form the basis of a new government. The original AR magazine. Extensively used during the American Vietnam War due to the technical restraints of the era. The now standard 30 round mags wouldn't go on to see widespread use until the mid to late 70's, well after the end of the war. These mags still tend to pop up & are used by small colonial armies on an extreme budget & law enforcement. Only compatible with the XM177 Commando or M16A2.
The original teleporter for the Novabot Facility. Its neglect resulted in a total breakdown.
The origins of the Protectorate. Such a massive empire formed from such a small country.

The people here look for better lives. This world is their last bastion of happiness, of life and joy.

Sister, are you listening?

The people of the Republic are primarily Scandinavian in ancestry and still hold heavy Christian values. Begrudgingly given asylum status by the original soviet government, it was inevitable that ethnic tensions would arise between the two vastly different cultures.

The planet cannot be saved. Not until we are ready for it to be saved. So surrender to us or die.

The player begins their journey with an old space vessel. The ship becomes usable after completing the first world. The interior space can be increased after that point by using scrap metal.
Interacting with the pilot seat will allow the player to select a world to fight on. Left-click on a star system or planet to select it for general info or to zoom in. Right-click to travel to that location. You can warp onto a planet once you are in close-orbit of a planet.
The power is out in this area, so this door isn't going to open. Try ^#71f2f6;using spacebar to jump^white; into the vent above us and use that to get through.
The propeller on this wind turbine never stops spinning.

The reformed people of my home have told me about New Londinium, God, and His love. But, does God love his own creations? I am a Youkai, in truth created by the lingering remnant of humanity within a forgotten umbrella... A heretic.

So I ran. Deep into the forest I well-knew was becoming home to an Abyssal force. I went on until I- I was here. Somewhere familiar yet- alien. For a short moment, I thought I could just settle down alone and become a hermit, smithing tools for noone. Of course, my own existence is bound to certain rules and it drew me towards the islands to seek new victims.
The regulator you've just picked up can be placed to block the surrounding area from being affected by deadly planetary hazards.
The robot-vendor will accept looted tech and other parts. It will spit out some decent albeit off-brand mech gear in return.

The sergeant major or píntano (Abudefduf saxatilis) is a species of damselfish. Sergeant majors earn their name from their brightly striped sides, known as bars, which are reminiscent of the insignia of a military sergeant major.
The ship's FTL drive runs on spookium, which is found on moons. I'm... not sure why, but since Earth was destroyed, there have been anomalous readings coming from almost every moon in the galaxy...
The ship's atmosphere is unsuitable for breathing, at least to you specifically. You can still suffocate within the vessel.

The short sword has been around since ancient times as the standard infantry weapon of shield infantry next to the common spear, being able to deliver slashes and thrusts in close-quarters. Beyond military application, they also made for good compact sidearms that would not impede movement or indicate hostile intent in town like a spear would.
^orange;2nd/4th strike DEFLECTS (resist melee).

The stronger the material, the better the weapon or object will turn out. Titanium is better than iron, but durasteel is better than titanium.
The sun's coming up, and the warmth of those rays is heating up the gases around us, which seems to reduce the severity of the pressure here.

The surface brings a conflict fuelled by politics in the aftermath of the Abyssal storm. One clings onto the echoes of a great power from Earth a thousand years ago. The other formed from the blanketing snow as a new force that threatens to replace the old.

May you seek faith, Shell.
The swift warrior fears not the globes.

The swordfish (Xiphias gladius) are large, highly migratory predatory fish characterized by a pointed bill. The popular image of the swordfish skewering its prey with its nose is based on little evidence. In a typical environment, swordfish most likely use their noses to slash at prey and inflict weakening injuries. The hypothesis that they may use their noses as spears in a defensive capacity against sharks and other predators is still under review (Gardieff, S. ''Swordfish'').
The tail of a helicopter. Always the target for anti-air. Always.

The taste and texture of beef can change drastically depending on how long it's cooked for. This dish has been carefully-prepared with rare Wagyu Beef.

^#FFB941;Quality Meat - +50HP restored.

The teleporter for the Novabot Facility. It has seen better days.

The theological divide between the Orthodox and Catholics has its roots in the Great Schism of 1054, which tore apart the Christian Church. A multitude of conflicts compounded over the centuries, of which were the increasingly entrenched theological disagreements between the Eastern and Western churches. The clergy disagreed over beliefs surrounding the Filioque, the use of leavened or unleavened bread in the Eucharist, the role of icons in worship, and the role of the pope.

The tools you brought me are nothing special, but they are mine. The very tools I carved my old life with.

I am Tatara Kogasa, and I will not have these abyssals take another life. Start the boat. We're leaving.

The very best that modern metallurgy can provide on an industrial-scale. Often space-age alloys and other such resilient materials, these are hard to come by alone and even harder to make without advanced refinery processes.
The voices just gave me a really great idea! Can you hear Them too? Such eloquent knowledge, that of the Great Old Ones!

The whole ordeal with a Razed planet is the kind of thing you'd see in a TV show. It's bloody fascinating seeing them fight the way they do, oblivious to the greater problems of the galaxy.

I'll tell one of the assistant fairies to keep tabs on that Razed planet in case anything else happens. Sending you there was more of a curiosity than anything, but it seems like it had the benefit of proving that you're not as daft as you made yourself out to be.
The wind is really picking up! The atmospheric pressure is going to increase from the change in wind speed.
The wood you're collecting is useful for a lot of stuff we're gonna be needing. Take a look at your crafting menu when you get the chance.
The workshop is divided into six categories; weapons, armory, furniture, radios, materials, and miscellaneous. Explore it, you'll get the hang of it.
The worst thing about having ADHD is the fact that I get distracted easily and- oooh, shiny star... Wait, I found a pixel under my chair! Woot! Free money.
The yellow lines indicate dangerous content inside. I should be mindful.

The yellowfin tuna (Thunnus albacares) is a species of tuna found in pelagic waters of tropical and subtropical oceans worldwide. Yellowfin tuna prey include other fish, pelagic crustaceans, and squid. Like all tunas, their body shape is particularly adapted for speed, enabling them to pursue and capture fast-moving baitfish such as flying fish, sauries, and mackerel.
Them ancients made a menacin' door.
Then I made a circuit to a place in which nothing was completed.

Then I've got something that might interest you. It's something big.

I've got a new file on a case called Eskhatos. There's an entire planet out there that's been placed into realspace. I swear on my mother that this is not some miscalculation. A planet slotted itself neatly into a star system, civilization and everything. Now here's the meat of it: This is an ancient civilization. Sent a few scouts and came back with information regarding two great Empires fighting over the ashes of the world. Their technological timeline places them somewhere in the 19th century, though it seems to be a mosh of technologies.
Then Uriel, one of the holy angels who was with me, and who conducted me, answered: Enoch, wherefore dost thou ask; wherefore reason with thyself, and anxiously inquire?
There ain't no worrying about dyin' now.
There are almost no life readings, as it seems that everyone escaped after lockdown, or probably died.

There are an alien peoples called the Druflorans who've been found lingering on the edge of human-colonized space. Most colonial superpowers seldom interfere with primitive species these days given the political ramifications of invading and murdering these cultures, but- well, the smaller powers try anyways.

The Druflorans on the Razed planet have gained a significant leap in technology, effectively cheating cultural developments by a few hundred years. There seems to be two sides of what seems to be a continent-spanning conflict: a very asiatic culture, and a vaguely modern-militaristic rebel force.
There are letters and numbers on this device.
There are some kooky things goin' on in this stuff. The heck are you gonna use it for?

There are some pieces of engineering that aren't toyed with for very practical reasons. How practical these designs are remain to be seen.

^#96CBE7;On Pickup: Learn how to craft the Ballistazooka, Powderzooka, and Hwachazooka at the Gunner and Fletcher Workstation.

There are some sorcerers that believe the day the sky burned was when we had lost our place. When metal boxes and barbarian books appeared from the Outside World. They are fools. The Tengu have betrayed the order. The natural order of Man's fear of youkai has been lost, for they now believe in a false God who in their primitive ape logic leads us astray to believe any God is above the deities of this land. It is our duty to restore what is only Mother Nature's course.

I must push on. This city must be captured before we can restore the natural order of the world.
There are some targets out here. Try using your mech's weapon to bust them to pieces!

There are some things that would still be seen today as magic. This paste has strange kinetic properties, allowing it to transfer the force of a bullet across the body in a way that seems to defy physics itself.

Sister, forgive them. They are not all the same.
There is a lethal amount of static electricity in the air here! It'll tear through your energy supply - you need protective equipment!

There is a place Tylian calls the 'Wildlands', a world untouched by the ravages of war yet inhabited by humans and faint traces of youkai who want nothing more than to live a new life amongst men. There, I believe an old friend of mine resides, attempting to use her old skills to stay afloat. She is a crow-tengu specifically. Shameimaru is her name.

I have no leads on the city, state, or country that she may be on. I only know that she is there somewhere. If you could tell her of the Bazaar, I would greatly appreciate your assistance.

There is hardly ever a good enough excuse for the commissars. Political officers ensure that there are a fresh supply of bodies to send to the front, and the line between able-bodied and disabled blurs with each cold night. For most, the threat of death is more than enough to 'volunteer'.

There's a Protectorate uniform in that locker. You should put it on, in case you get caught here.

There's a few projects we're running around here. Mine is figuring out something big that happened 20 or so years ago. You heard of The Rapturing? Whole chunks of the United Systems core worlds went up and out, gone, poof. It's the whole reason the galaxy's up in flames, power vacuum up to infinity out there, and why this place is the way it is. Somewhere in-between realspace and whatever happened to the United Systems.

Come see me when you're ready. Brooks will take you there.

These apes don't know what's coming to them. Let them have all the bullets!

These electric storms are deadly when you're on the surface. If you head underground, you'll be safe from lightning strikes.

These new neo-soviets are like children playing blocks with a dead empire. They're trying to grasp glory that isn't theirs and people will suffer for it. It's the eastern bloc all over again.

Right, thanks for the data. I don't have anything exciting to give you on these developments. Again, more curiosities. The more we compile on the galactic scene, the more it just looks like history playing out again.

These radio messages are so fucking stupid. They're like "This stuff is an absolute staple in all aspects of your lab work that you're totally going to be doing because I have hereforth decided you're a scientist for some fucking reason!" And then you look at the item and it's some vague shit like "Metallic Substance" and it's completely removed from the entire fucking game.
These rooms are quite dangerous and are riddled with traps. If you don't feel confident trying any of these, feel free to leave and return once you feel confident.
They didn't even hesitate, did they? I've got all of his items packed in here. Mail, but also some strange papers and personal items. Rest your soul, Bradley.

They fight over the last scraps of this world. The little joy they had, the pleasures of this world... gone. Their faces sapped of life.

Sister, look, it's home. Our home.

They had guns that could shoot without reloading... They didn't need to stop to ram a new round down the barrel. They just kept on shooting us. Bang after bang after bang, a never-ending barrage of noise... but we kept pushing on... we pushed on with nothing but crossbow and musket.

They look like space cats, but don't call them 'cats' lightly where they can hear you. A curious people, peaceful on the surface, but just as often vicious and cunning. They have increased jumping height and softer landings.
They will do anything to delay your actions. Exercise caution and aggression.
They're amassing a large formation of rifle troops. Prepare to dig in!
They're backing off a bit! We should have some time before they push us again! About two minutes!
They're coming over the hill! Get ready!
They're done! Everyone, start moving in! We've got ground to take!
They're getting desperate! We break them here and now! Get ready!
They're marching towards us! Everyone ready yourself!
They're nearly here! Take positions!
They're not lying.
They're pulling back for their final assault! Dig in as much as you can with the two minutes we have!
They're pulling back! We got only a minute before another attack!
They're starting to thin out! Hey, friend, have a quick run over that way and see if there's any more of them!
They're throwing stuff outta the windows! Keep your heads down. They'll run out eventually, so be patient! Then, we move in and take care of the rest!
They've got nowhere to go! Kill them all! Don't let any of the bastards escape!
Things are going to get a whole lot colder here at night. I think you had better find a source of warmth.
This Augment provides no stat improvements or effective resistances. It does however prevent you from being electronically marked from certain turrets.

This ^orange;endomorphic jelly^reset; is some kind of... stuff. I... think you could try making it into... something? Probably more random armor or whatever.

This iconic model is often within arm's reach of Novakid merchants and smugglers (if there was any difference to begin with). Protectorate officials typically turn a blind-eye to these firearms, brushing them off as ''cultural'' weapons that are consistent with Novakid tastes despite their ironic origins. Holds two ^yellow;6x52mm bullets^reset; loaded in a break-action fashion.

This is General Anton Golubev. We know exactly what you're trying to do, and will see to it that you are stopped by any means necessary! We will not allow you to destroy over two decades of hard work!
This is ^orange;corvex^reset;. I don't know what it is, but it can do some weird, weird stuff, that you wouldn't expect anything to scientifically be able to even do.
This is ^orange;irradium^reset;, and it makes your Geiger counter sing like an Avian! Its radioactivity can be made dormant, and it can then be made into some dangerous equipment, or strong alloys.
This is a Buff Module! You can use it to boost one of your abilities for a couple minutes. You can only be using one at a time, though, so try to think it through first.
This is a ^#71f2f6;Matter Manipulator^white;! It's a tool that can deconstruct matter. We can use it to clear out the rubble blocking us from getting to your ship.
This is a bloodstain. Seems recent.
This is a chest. Whatever is inside of it must be important.
This is actually gonna be kinda fun! I'll get to see you graduate through your own point of view, rather than having to sit over in the audience!
This is advertising something about 'voting'. Whatever that means.
This is an OddJob radio. Activating oddjobs will allow you to benefit from some battles with additional rewards. This one is tied to the Loyalists. [currently only 1 added]
This is an old ruin situated deep in a forest. Supposedly, there's quite a few Floran artifacts located there.
This is just a symbol that indicates the local power is not allied to a superpower.
This is not an ATM.
This is pretty much just harder rocks..
This is the control chip for a Precursor drone, and it's actually still functional! If you use it on the ship, we can try it out.

This is the data? Alright, this should do.

You've probably figured it out already given the stuff that I handle, but I deal with the byproducts of extensive magical energies. Artifacts are the results of these supernatural storms that as far as I can tell these soviets were trying to meddle with. They never should have tried to do the things they did, and now they're paying the price. Wouldn't be the first time the commies tried to fuck up a world.
This is the kind of car you'd see in some zombie film.

This is the last kill-order I have for you. We're looking at a dangerous Youkai Hell-Raven who's overstepped her authority on the planet. Look, I have my orders. Maybe there'll be another way in the future, but not this time.

This is the right one. Thank you.

Please visit my store if you feel that you need something for your travels. I have everything you will need from the bare components to something more complete, if you'd rather have me make something for you. I am more than capable of making tools for the master assassin or fighter, just be sure to bring me weapon parts.

I promise that my prices are fair, given that I'd rather not see you strewn across the ground.

This isn't half-bad. A few times I had to open up holes in german houses way back in the day. These little firing ports you could shoot out of. It's stupid simple how you could see way out from behind a firing port but the enemy could barely see you when they try to look for you.

This journey has you going pretty far! You're gonna need an upgrade before you continue on. If you get me some more materials for a project I am working on, I'll give you a ^blue;Rare Blueprint Drive^reset; in exchange.
This key leads to the two armories of the police station. Perhaps it could benefit the remaining officers.

This key looks like it's about to fall apart. Fucking dumbfucks must've left it soaking. Alright fine, I'll tell you what I know.

Me and my boys have been eyeballing his property for a while, looking to do an easy grab-and-bag operation. Guy's wealthy. Fancy car and all. We're casing the place when we see robed figures come from the alleys. They unlock his door, probably with a copy of his key they got from somewhere. They drag the bastard out and then down into the basement of the place.

The old man thinks we should just convert to standard combustion engines for our power. I have some projects I wanted to do that need that extra power, but I don't want to bully him over it.

This place... Many have no homes to call their own. They no longer hold onto hope.

Sister, please stay with us.

This portrait acts like a light as well as art.

I have reason to believe this to be a result of attempted colonization attempts that underestimated the Drufloran's propensity to adapt and survive.

The asiatic culture is an interesting case. This is the part that's curious, as they most resemble Shogunate-Era Japan. We're just short of these items. If you could please buy these it would be very nice of you, dearie. You should be able to buy these from a Bowerbird store on the Wildlands world. Most space colonies otherwise don't seem to stock anything tasteful. Nobody wants to eat their food on a metal table.

I would go out myself, but I haven't been able to retract my wings since a long time ago... and, well, I am very pink. It would cause quite a stir. We'll start working once you bring the furniture. Thank you dearie.
We're working on it! ETA: 1 minute! We're alerting the others now!
We've done it! They're scattered! We've beat them back!
We've just entered a zero-gravity environment. You'll want to keep yourself inside the mech for now, because it's designed to fly through space too.

We... won. We won. We won the battle and held off the bandits... but there's so much blood on my hands now... that rush of battle... But just like with Bada, it was self-defense! I just had wished there was some other way to talk to those people.

Weapon Proficiency is a statistic that determines either HIT CHANCE for conventional firearms (Assault Rifles, Submachine Guns, Pistols, etc) or CRIT CHANCE for unconventional ranged weapons (throwing weapons, bows, muzzleloaders, etc).
The left value represents the standing value. The right value represents the crouched value (usually better with long weapons such as rifles, but not as affected with lighter weapons such as pistols or bows). It does not affect melee weapons and some throwables.
Weapons of all types exist out there in the universe; ballistic, explosive, energy, and even melee weapons. All of them are fun and easy to obtain.

Welcome, Shell.

You walk the ashen soil of Eskhatos, where the desperate and the destructive make their mark on a world at the end of an age.

The inhabitants of this world are fearful, fighting only out of loyalty to their own survival and willing to destroy their own kind, much like Man and their so-called youkai counterpart do.
Well, I guess it's on me for giving you the Neki armor blueprints, of all things.
Well, I'm not sure what you did to get yourself here, but fortunately, your ship is still in one piece. It's sitting on the roof of the complex, so let's go find it!
Well, I'm sure you'll figure it out. Let's keep up the march. Any brigand is gonna think twice before trifling with us.

Well, bugger. I don't know what I expected from a bunch of tribes slamming their heads together. It'd be like if you gave a bunch of stupid people power armor and expected them to fight competently.

You know, in my time, there were always those sci-fi stories that asked the question of bringing in a handful of modern soldiers into the past. Ten US Marines versus ten-thousand Confederates. That kind of stuff. Honestly, my opinion? Gets kind of boring after a while. It just boils down to slaughtering the more primitive side, and it's not exactly the most interesting outcome innit?
Well, gee, not even a sprint could get us through these doors, huh? I sorta wish it was me getting all this neat mobility tech.
Well, isn't that something? This ancient door looks like it leads to a pocket dimension containing some kind of trial. If you wanna hop in, we can find out...

Well, it does, but not in the way the elders are worried about. The crop harvests haven't just been bad in this area. It's been bad all over the nation, and without anywhere else to go to we'll end up hunter-gatherers again. Kid, don't forget that the whole of human history isn't just on this world. We came from way above. We lived it, man.
Well, it looks like your Shining Dark has abandoned you. Until then, we'll look after you the same way you looked after your victims.
Well, maybe no one would think it's weird, exactly, but they'd sure be checking you out.
Well, now that the sun's down, the heat here should subside a little. The night's dark, but at least it's a lot cooler.
Well, now you are in posession of the knowledge belonging to an arms dealer. Sheila Torryx is her name. She grants permission for you to use her stuff if you don't turn her in. Fair trade, I guess.
Well, would you look at that? It looks like there's actually some kind of ^orange;radio broadcast coming through this thing^reset;. Give it a listen.
Well, you know now, I guess. I am an Arms Dealer... Not the best trade for someone sworn to spread peace throughout the galaxy... but it does bring in good money.
Wh- What do you want? Who are you?!
What a waste of potential tech.
What a weird little thing. A ^orange;strange nodule^reset; like this is full of unusual, alien genes; you could probably make some interesting biology experiments out of it.
What about the brigands? The soldiers are saying they're getting more bold nowadays.
What an odd thing that is. I'm not sure what it does, or how old it is. Hopefully, putting it under a ^orange;microscope^reset; could tell us something about it.
What are you doing, digging up ore in this day and age? What'cha gonna do, smelt 'em into bars and use 'em to make equipment? Is this the Bronze Age? Look at you go.

What choice did we have? They would not even send a message to colonial authorities, something that would be so incredibly easy for them to do. That, is how much they despised us from the beginning. How much they loathed us. Loathed everyone but themselves. They turned away from God and yet they wore the flesh of righteousness, labelling us as heretics that only deserved death on the end of their gun. They shot at us for decades if anyone dared cross their path.
What do you call a wearable poptop? A croptop. Hehe.

What do you want? You know what I did, and I don't regret a sliver of what we had to do. They were corrupt. Slimy. The Shining Dark saw through their veil and we saw to it to fulfil our duty. You know what happens next when they come. Leave me be.
What happened here? This place looks completely abandoned.
What if this was all just a giant, side-scrolling simulation and we were all being controlled by fleshy otherly-world beings from behind computer screens?
What is your favorite element? Mine is fire! Represents warmth and power. Nothing wrong with that.
What is your favorite genre of music? As you can tell, mine is classic rock. I have a lot of favorites, but I think 'In the Air Tonight' is my favorite one so far.
What is your favorite movie franchise? Mine is Star Wars! I love the Podracing part in Episode One.
What surprises will I find in this temple?
What the heck is this anomaly? When I look into it my head spins.
What the hell?! Morphite?! Did you just create a new element?!

What was that?...

Alright, I'm going to make this quick. I'll get to work on the pictures and bagging anything that might be useful for us later. I'm not stupid, I think someone doesn't like us being here. Head back up and keep them off my back.

그게 뭐였죠?...

좋아요, 빨리 끝내겠습니다. 사진 작업을 하고 나중에 우리에게 유용할 수 있는 것을 챙기겠습니다. 저는 바보가 아닙니다. 누군가가 우리가 여기 있는 것을 좋아하지 않는 것 같습니다. 영화나 게임에서 일어나는 일이고, 지금도 확실히 일어나고 있다고 생각합니다. 위로 올라가서 그들이 나를 방해하지 않도록 해주세요.

englishText: What you've just picked up is called ^orange;lasombrium^reset;, and it is a really creepy metal that phases in and out of reality, apparently. That is all the data I have on it.
What's he doing down there? No blimmin' way I'm going to try to arrest him now.
What's this? Is this? Blood?
What's your favorite color? Mine is pink... don't ask why I don't decorate my armor and weapons with pink. It looks better in red and black.
What, you can't handle a bit of cold?
What? When has that ever happened before? How am I suppose to know which thing you're referencing among the thousands of years of media we've accumulated?
Whatever this stuff is, it's the most radioactive thing I've ever seen. We'll catalog it as "ultronium", because that sounds appropriately cool.
Wheat Harvest

Wheat has been a staple crop since the dawn of human agriculture. Best grown in large numbers.

^orange;Can be planted to grow wheat. Wheat harvests can wildly vary in quantity and may sometimes yield failed crops.
Wheat that has been consumed by pests or destroyed by other means. It is unusable for processing.
Wheat, a staple crop.
When I have the resources to, I will be making the biggest, most sturdy, and technologically advanced box fort you will ever see... just you wait.
When the Shining Dark comes, you will be NOTHING!
When you get the chance, you should see if you can put together a ^orange;Hazard Lab Table^reset;. You'll be able to make protective equipment there.
When your mech is in an environment with gravity, it'll activate its legs. Go ahead and walk through in the mech here.

Where I beheld the operation of a great fire blazing and glittering, in the midst of which there was a division. Columns of fire struggled together to the end of the abyss, and deep was their descent.
Where do you go when you die in hell?... I guess when I get to you, time will tell...
Where the hell is Shimano!? My sword is marked with his name! He must be bled!
Whew... ^green;Okay, you made it!^reset; That was ridiculous. You should go back and talk to Dr. Akaggy now.

While Erchius has been known to convert living and dead biomass into monsters, Pericarpyx works with unparalleled efficiency in living organisms, rapidly diverting bodily resources toward crystalline buildup in the victim's bloodstream that is then shunted to the brain, killing the host with a conventional aneurysm that is iconic and indistinguishable from a normal Erchius infection's progression.
  
^red;- Afflicts Pericarpyx Infection.
While I applaud that you have found yourself enjoying the likes of my creator's caffeinated beverages, just remember that caffeine is addicting. Drink in moderation.

While I'm stuck as a little computer in your head, I can refer to SAIL's entire database, and I can teach you to craft almost anything imaginable, step by step! You should start by making an ^orange;inventor's table^reset;.

While early Gensokyo did not ban electrical forms of attack, magicians who dabbled in low-lethality lightning streams were frowned upon due to their tendency to cause suffering in those they electrocuted. The war between the Separatists and Christians reignited this field of weapons development but neither side would effectively field arc weapons until much later.

^#8FAED3;Spells: Electrical Arc [FIRE] | Enhanced Electrical Arc [CRIT] | Lightning Artillery [ALT | Gensidium Shard]

While modern wonders have made life even more convenient for those lucky enough to live in the lavish high-rises of cities, their shadow is cast over those left to fend for themselves down below. Magic was once the wonder of imagination in the past, filled with wonders where one's problems could be easily mitigated. Now it is merely another scientific field to scrutinize, and another weapon to fine-tune.
^#8FAED3;Spells: Arc Bolt [FIRE] | Overcharged Arc Bolt [CRIT] | Lightning Discharge [ALT | Gensidium Shard]
While not very vibrant, it does complement the loneliness of the stars. Just like the person sitting in it.
While the Starwalker set was designed for space, the jetpack tech is a bit finicky. Pair it with the flight stabilizers to be able to propel through space outside of your mech.

Whilst the Tengu were benevolent, they did not trust Mankind to rule over themselves. When the Tengu council finally decided to repel the feral youkai from the 'hunting grounds', they demanded that an Emperor be crowned, guided only by the Tengu. It did not take long for the power dynamic to shift, however. Loads Shot.

Who did what to make who mad this time?

Whoa, there, hold on. Lasombrium seeds? This stuff is, like, MADE of evil. You might want to wash your hands after handling it.
Whoa. The cosmic energy levels here are increasing very sharply. The sun seems to keep it down during the day, but it looks like it gets worse in the night.
Whoever made this entrance was very unoriginal.
Whoo-ey! Looks like the guns the blacksmiths make.
Why do I have 4K evidence of you EGGING MY HOUSE?!
Why do they look familiar?

With a campfire, you can cook some basic food. Until we get you to a kitchen, you'll have to make do with skewered alien meat and boiled rice, I guess...

With nothing else to go off on, your only lead is towards the mountain and apparently towards a battle. The only possible hope you have of even confirming he went down such a trail is if any of his belongings were to be found.
With paint, you can paint. Paint blocks. You can't paint pictures. And neither can I.

With the Satori killed and the Republic reinforcements slaughtered, the facility that once was fades away under the choking snow. The loss of even one of their Behemoth Trains determines their desperate civilization towards an agonizing fate.
With the core Dark One contained and the Reality Anchors reactivated, the last few remaining creatures of the night seek refuge in the abandoned halls of the Bunker Complex.

Word travelled fast. Julian had gone missing only a few weeks after my departure and his fiefdom had collapsed to petty power struggles. So I kept moving with what money I had left. No one was going to be friends with a 'terror' who scares their hearts out with illusion magic, so I kept moving around aimlessly, village-to-village. Was hard to stay disguised near people forever, though. My illusion magic can't change the colors of my eyes, and it's quite easy to recognize my red and blue.
Worker's Crowbar
World's Edge
Worn Concrete Grassy
Worn Concrete Red Grassy
Worried. I may end up like this if I'm not careful.
Worried. That's the equivalent of being dismembered in Glitch terms.

Would you ever think to love me?

Of course, I do love you.

Isn't that how humanity moulded youkai like me?

Would you happen to know about any ^orange;archaic energy sources^reset; on this planet? I've detected one nearby. ^green;We can check it out^reset;... or, we can just carry on with our interstellar camping trip, if you want.
Wouldn't wanna be stuck in that stuff.
Wow... I can't believe this actually works. A beautiful weapon that would make the Cultivator proud... I wish I was there to actually use it.
Wrench (GiC)

Yeah, can do. When do you guys plan to leave?
Yeah, our ship's not lookin' pretty right now. You oughta ^green;beam down and have a look around on the planet we're orbiting. ^cyan;I pray we can find something to fix this mess.
Yellow-Fin Tuna
Yellowfin Tuna
Yep, this confirms it. It's a nest of grossness. Burn it with fire!

Yes! We'll get married!

I know the place! Come on then!
Yes, I like rainbows... got a problem with it?

Yes. I am Nitori. I'm coming to ask if you'd let me have a closer look at your... crossbow. I've not seen something like that before... you made this?

[Bada hands over his repeating crossbow to Nitori]

Yet when we made it through their walls, they would not surrender. Every single one of them. Man, woman... I did not see any children... I hope to God there were none.

Just who the fuck were we fighting?... Why did they choose to fight? What drove them to such lengths? They bore the Lord's cross, but...

Yet you? You have been the worst of them. You blinded our kind into believing that they are better than us. That they should no longer fear us as they have for hundreds of years. You encourage them to rebel against us!

No longer are we free to feast on them. They hunt us down, and we are forced to conform to their rules. They now believe themselves as Gods over us, while you allow them to worship the false idol they call ''Christ''. When us youkai are no longer feared in these lands, when the cycle has broken, what then? We will be erased from this world.
Yikes! A giant icicle!
Yo, buddy, you're gonna need that Matter Manipulator! Go back and grab it, now!

You approach a kneeling man, possibly a soldier, covered and impaled by roots. You swear you can feel a malevolent presence surrounding the very air itself. The Holbeck denizens need to be made aware of this.
You be careful out there, now. This place looks pretty dangerous, even in a mech.
You can also use throwable hunting spears to carve meat from monsters. They're slow, and heavy, but they're powerful.
You can't bring any more crew members with you. You'll have to leave one of them on the ship if you want to bring someone else.

You come help my fellow crewmen with this job and I'll have ye' rewarded handsomely. Most of the treasure's mine of course, you're getting paid to find it, not keep it. Need those funds for the warchest, softskin. If there's enough gold to find, maybe you'll be out of whatever it is you're wearing in no time!

So how say of ye'? Care for a little adventure out towards the isles? I'll be around for a while but don't fuck around too much 'eh?
You could actually fit through that opening, if you were to make a ^orange;Microsphere tech^reset; on your ^orange;Tricorder^reset;'s Tech Craft tab.

You did fine work getting that treasure. Now there wasn't much treasure for any of us so you're only gettin' paid in a percent of what you found. That means you're entitled to a few days worth of rations. Look, you're like an alien to us here, and I'll be damned if you didn't just fall from the sky, so I don't want to hear you whinging.

But if you've got the drive for adventure... I can promise you shiploads of treasure on our next expedition, if you've got the stones for it, of course. Like last time, don't fuck around. Be ready for it, mate.
You did it! Now you can get your ship repaired.
You did it! You got your very first crewmember! If you want to see more information about them, you can check on the terminal.
You don't look like you belong. Ohhhhh, you're like one of those detectives... Probably got no help from the coppers too, so you're out here asking the homeless for help...

You don't need to worry about a crew, now. Your ship's in safe hands with me. If I were you, I'd love having a spaceship to myself! But, hey, if you wanna recruit some people to help out, it's your call; just please make sure they know what they're doing...
You got an enhancement pack! They'll give you a variety of boosts to your abilities. You can improve them with augments, too.
You got bamboo! It's, uh... You can, uh... You can build with it.
You got coal! Plunk a little chunk of that stuff onto a piece of wood, and that'll give you a torch. As you know. As... everyone knows, actually.
You got some ^orange;fertilizer^reset;! If you have any plants in growing trays, they will just love this stuff.

You have a moment?

[Wymond reveals a funerary urn from inside the box]

You have done me a great service. This will be the last time I'll ask you to get me something. It's for a prototype solarium reactor that I am making for my ship. It works, but I need prism shards and solarium stars. Get that for me, and I'll give you access to all my top-tier items.
You have found an area that can only be accessed by a cheater. Well done!
You have lost some energy. Hold ^green;[Space]^reset; to replenish this energy that you have lost.
You have no inactive crew members right now. Crew members become inactive if you exceed the amount of active crew members your ship can support.
You kiddin' me? You could literally SWIM in this armor! As in, go to the beach with it and no one would bat an eye!

You know already, but I'm Aya Shameimaru, now I'd say a former civil journalist. I don't think it takes much to know that I'd consider myself of Japanese origin, though I sometimes doubt if that's really the case.

I like home-cooked foods. It's always something that comes from a person's heart, and of course it can always make a good picture for a food article. Speaking of articles, I don't think there's an article I couldn't make. My old friends would always get on me for spreading my journalism too far, like that uhm, Icarus figure.

You know, I have to say, I'm glad I'm an AI right now, because otherwise I would get nightmares having been in the mere presence of whatever unholy incarnation of a crafting table you just acquired. I would SERIOUSLY watch it around that thing.
You know, this looks like those videogames where the option is like greyed out or has a cross through it to indicate it's not selectable. Yeah, this is it.
You look like you could use some extra protection. We'll join you if you can spare the food. We're looking to see what this campaign order they're sending out is all about.

You must be. My name is Nitori Kawashiro. I am a Kappa, but foremost I am an engineer and tradeswoman. I once was part of a much bigger group of my own kind who relished in technology, but it's been some time since I've seen them.

Perhaps you would be interested in my store, however. I can deal with specialized ammunition, attachments, and equipment that might help you.

Maybe we can be friends. I'll make you a deal then.
You need to get to the ship, as soon as possible! ^#71f2f6;Crouch with S and tap the spacebar^white; to climb down a platform!
You notice something glistening in the flickering light from behind the cabinet.

You really did clear 'em, didn't you? Scouts are saying a few brigands are turning tail and running from the place now. Well, you've clearly proven yourself, so you're in. Come see me when you're all geared up and ready to go.

Just make sure that this is what you want. We're pouring everything we've got into this operation and good men are going to die. Don't join in on this if you don't think it's best for you.

You really, really should just listen to some Pendulum. You're not going to see this message ingame anyway because I have no fucking idea what it's even for and the code for the entirety of Frackin' Universe comes up with literally nothing, so I'm just going to use this space to tell you to listen to Pendulum. Try Witchcraft or Propane Nightmares first. That shit will change your life. It changed mine.
You say that there is a place I can go to, away from here? Well, I'm not sure if I could recreate what you did but I'll try. I'd do anything to get away from this place and into the stars.
You see those white capsules on the ground? Smash them. They have useful tools for survival and a small amount of money inside. Good for building up a great fortune.

You seek, Shell.

You walk the frozen hell of the Khurtovynan world, where the weak and the afraid value their political rivalries over their own continued survival.

The inhabitants of this world are entrenched against each other in a campaign to unite the remnants of this world under the old People's Army, or the new Republic.

You seem weary, dearie. If you are ever in need of a drink or just a good meal, come to me. I may not be the best cook in this new realm, but I promise you that I can make you a nice meal that can wipe your worries away.

So if you have some spare money, I can reserve you a decent meal. Much better than those tasteless rations. You all deserve much better food, so if you ever have the time... just see me, okay dearie?
You seen that floating ghost thingy on moons? It seems to like Erchius Crystals and whomever collects them.

You sought, Shell.

You walk the hallways of the decayed Protected world, where the immoral and the ignorant sought their dominion over the population.

The inhabitants of this world are generally human, but some are made of false flesh and steel. They are unthinking automatons, an affront not unlike a Shell.

You sure as hell brought in one hell of a case. The man dresses almost like an ancient-timey Royal Navy admiral. We've got plenty of funny people who'd already be out of place out there, but this Thomas guy you brought in is somehow even more out of place that I would've thought he was just some cosplayer at first.

We found him walking around aimlessly in one of the back alleys, blank-faced. He didn't say anything, just stared at everyone with wide eyes. He's in a holding room now, being tended to by one of the fairy nurses.
You think you have won? Your Gods have abandoned you, and the Shining Dark chooses us over your pathetic reign.
You think?

You want to go on... a date? I mean... sure, why not. We've been through some things haven't we? I've got first rights to where we're going then. I choose... Hmm...

I think...

There's a small shop back in that city I'd like to see again. I'm sure Jakobson has the place under control now, so safety shouldn't be a concern anymore. They do have some lovely stir fry there. So how about it?
You want to... get married?

You want to... have a date? With me? I'm sure you know that I am not truly a human, right?

Perhaps you jest so...

You will encounter various merchants across your travels, who will offer different supplies and equipment for purchase.

Many will only handle currencies local to the world you're on, such as of those on Garden who only handle Grain Bags. Other more open markets may accept the standard physical Credits. Consider the local economy and make sure to pay attention to anything unique they may sell!

You will encounter various transitional triggers that take you to other maps or levels.
Lantern Bonfires - Saves local area and can transition to other areas.
Blue Exit Zones - Same as Lantern Bonfires.
Red Exit Zones - Only transitions to another area.
Signpost with Light - Same as Lantern Bonfires, though rarely acts as Red Exit Zones.
Bazaar Shrine - Same as Lantern Bonfires.

You will find yourself embodying those of the memory, but I warn you, failing to properly 'play' the role will lead to memory instability. Such destabilization will eventually kill you, if you refuse to stabilize it yourself.

I do not typically grant the powers to seek the knowledge of the past, but you are a Shell, and for that you are already dead.

You'd think an entire society of peasant-survivors would know more on living out in the woods, huh? One time me and my buddies were attached to a battalion that had recently won their first battle. They were understandably high on their victory against the enemy but they all seemed to egg my boys on claiming that we were too old to fight this war... One of these guys... No coal for the grill, so he started shoving wet, thick firewood into it. Nearly burnt himself after trying to pour gasoline in and lighting up the grill.

[The convo appears to continue on for some time, with Bada continuing to tell his life story to Tylian]
You'll need to ^orange;upgrade your Hazard Lab Table^reset; to make ^green;strong enough gear to protect against this fully.

You're about to head into dangerous territory. I suggest looking to upgrade once more. I got a small list, but numerous in quantity. It's best not to explain its purpose, but it will reward you a ^purple;Legendary Blueprint Drive^reset; upon completion. Trust me, you'll need it.

You're an immortal, aren't you? You have that distinct waft about you. The smell of potential, and depravity. An Immortal Shell, yet to learn of this new reality. Capable of growth and equally capable of degeneracy, but still only a hollow Shell...

This is the Bazaar Betwixt Realms, you can think of it as a sort of celestial settlement. It's a place where life is *almost* normal for those who have been displaced by unnatural means, perhaps not unlike you. Not that many would remain here, however.

The name's Tylian Fernsby. I run this place to make sure it remains aloft in its supernatural state. I was once a soldier and... a mediator. Nothing that my old lives could give me now. Well then, perhaps I'll tell what of you.
You're covered in water during an electrical storm like this?! You're like a walking lightning rod now!
You're forgetting something important about your lungs: THEY. NEED. OXYGEN! Get a breathing EPP or you're going to suffocate!
You're forgetting something important about your lungs: THEY. NEED. OXYGEN! Get yourself a source of air or you're going to suffocate!
You're not normally supposed to be getting a weapon just yet, and I don't know where the damn things are, so just take whatever you find in that chest! It'll work for now!
